'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[Iran–Israel conflict during the Syrian civil war]]
***[[July 2022 Israeli Damascus Governorate airstrikes]]
****An [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli]] [[airstrike]] kills three [[Syrian soldier]]s, injures seven others and destroys an [[Iran]]ian weapons depot near [[Damascus]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20220722-israeli-strike-kills-three-syrian-soldiers-near-damascus-syrian-ministry (AFP via France 24)]
**[[Russian military intervention in the Syrian civil war]]
***Russia launches five airstrikes on [[Jisr ash-Shughur]], killing seven people, including four children. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/jul/22/russian-airstrike-on-rebel-held-region-in-idlib-syria-kills-seven-people (''The Guardian'')]
*Aftermath of the [[Second Libyan Civil War]]
**Thirteen people are killed as fighting occurs in [[Tripoli, Libya|Tripoli]], [[Libya]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/reports-dead-libya-clashes-strike-capital-2022-07-22/ (Reuters)]
*[[Mali War]]
**The [[Macina Liberation Front]] launches an attack on [[Mali]]'s largest military base in [[Bamako]]. One soldier and six of the attackers are killed. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/heavy-gunfire-heard-main-mali-military-base-2022-07-22/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*The [[Paso Internacional Los Libertadores|main border crossing]] between [[Argentina]] and [[Chile]] reopens after several days of closure due to heavy snowfall. [https://news.yahoo.com/argentina-chile-mountain-border-reopens-164224616.html (Yahoo! News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Singapore]]
****[[Singapore]] reports its first six local cases of the BA.2.75 Centaurus variant as part of the [[Ministry of Health (Singapore)|Ministry of Health]]’s surveillance of the [[COVID-19]] situation in the country. However, the MOH says that the variant isn’t considered a [[variant of concern]] by the [[World Health Organization]]. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/singapore/6-local-covid-19-cases-ba275-centaurus-subvariant-moh-2829591 (CNA)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Taiwan]]
****[[Taiwan]] reports its first case of the [[SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant#BA.2.75|Omicron]] [[BA.2.75|BA.2.75 Centaurus variant]], in a Taiwanese individual arriving from [[India]]. [https://www.taiwannews.com.tw/en/news/4603589 (''Taiwan News'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]]
***[[France]] reports their first three cases of the BA.2.75 Centaurus variant, including one in the [[Occitania]] region. [https://www.technicalripon.com/covid-three-first-cases-of-the-ba-2-75-sub-variant-known-as-centaur-detected-in-france-including-one-in-occitania/ (Technical Ripon)] 
*[[2022–2023 mpox outbreak|2022 monkeypox outbreak]]
**[[2022–2023 mpox outbreak in the United States|2022 monkeypox outbreak in the United States]]
***The first cases of [[mpox|monkeypox]] in children in the [[United States]] are reported, with one being in [[California]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2022/07/22/health/monkeypox-children-vaccine/index.html (CNN)]
***[[Maine]] reports its first case of monkeypox. [https://www.wabi.tv/2022/07/22/maine-cdc-identifies-first-case-monkeypox-state/ (WABI-TV)]
**[[Monaco]] and [[Bermuda]] report their first cases of monkeypox. [https://news.mc/2022/07/21/monkeypox-has-made-its-way-to-monaco/ (News Monaco)] [https://www.royalgazette.com/health/news/article/20220721/bermuda-confirms-first-case-of-monkeypox/ (''Royal Gazette'')]
*The [[Nuclear Regulation Authority]] of [[Japan]] formally approves the release of a million tons of treated water from the [[Fukushima Daiichi Nuclear Power Plant]] into the [[Pacific Ocean]]. The plan had already been endorsed by the [[Japanese government]] and other agencies. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/international-news/20220722-japan-regulator-oks-release-of-treated-fukushima-water (Radio France International)]

'''International relations'''
*[[United Kingdom–European Union relations]]
**[[Brexit]]
***The [[European Commission]] launches four new legal procedures against the [[United Kingdom]] for alleged infringements of the [[Brexit withdrawal agreement|Brexit Withdrawal Agreement]] relating to the passage of the [[Northern Ireland Protocol Bill]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/7/22/eu-launches-new-legal-procedures-against-uk-over-northern-ireland (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Russia–Ukraine relations]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Russia]] and [[Ukraine]] sign a [[UN]]-backed agreement to allow the export of millions of tonnes of grain from blockaded [[Black Sea]] ports. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/jul/22/ukraine-russia-sign-un-backed-deal-restart-grain-exports (''The Guardian'')]
*[[North Korea–South Korea relations]]
**[[South Korea]] announces that it will lift a decades-long ban on public access to [[North Korea]]n television, newspapers and other media. [https://apnews.com/article/seoul-south-korea-newspapers-f62d8349928116800380ab927f563c09 (AP)]
*[[Russia–Transnistria relations]]
**Transnistrian [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Transnistria)|Foreign Minister]] Vitaly Ignatyev reaffirms that [[Transnistria]] is committed to becoming an independent state and is open to the possibility of uniting with Russia in the future. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-moscow-peacekeeping-forces-european-union-0f1967d2b0952b010336dad08fbd3f56 (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Aftermath of the January 6 United States Capitol attack]]
**[[Criminal proceedings in the January 6 United States Capitol attack]]
***Former [[Counselor to the President|White House Chief Strategist]] [[Steve Bannon]] is found guilty of [[contempt of Congress]] after defying the [[January 6th Committee|January 6 committee]] that investigates [[January 6 United States Capitol attack|the riot]] at the [[United States Capitol]]. [https://www.reuters.com/legal/government/prosecutors-set-urge-conviction-trump-ex-adviser-bannon-2022-07-22/ (Reuters)]
*[[2022 Sri Lankan protests]]
**The [[Sri Lankan Armed Forces|military]] and police raid an anti-[[government of Sri Lanka|government]] protest camp in [[Colombo]], and arrest nine people. [https://www.smh.com.au/world/asia/sri-lankan-army-raids-protest-camp-ahead-of-new-cabinet-appointments-20220722-p5b3rd.html (''The Sydney Morning Herald'')]
*[[Rohingya genocide case]]
**The [[International Court of Justice]] rejects the [[State Administration Council|Myanmar military junta]]’s challenge of the case against [[Myanmar|the country]] for its role in the [[Rohingya genocide]]. [https://apnews.com/article/africa-religion-genocides-asia-8df406e4ffeda932962ac425fdb5877f (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2022 Papua New Guinean general election]]
**[[Prime Minister of Papua New Guinea|Prime Minister]] [[James Marape]]'s [[Pangu Pati]] wins the general election. [https://www.onepng.com/2022/07/2022-png-election-results-declared-seats.html (One Papua New Guinea)]
